facts.name: Snapdragon
facts.color: Spikes of pink, red, yellow, white or bicolor
facts.notes: Spikes of 'dragon-mouth' flowers in almost every color, from dwarf 6-inch edging types to 3-foot cut flowers. A cool-weather annual: it can go out in spring before other annuals and keeps blooming into fall until a hard frost. It may slow down in midsummer heat. Cut off faded spikes for more flowers, and stake the tall kinds.

sources.title: MIgardener (Michigan seed company): Appleblossom Snapdragon
sources.note: Snapdragon (Antirrhinum majus) seed sold by a Michigan company; up to 2.5 ft, double flowers in rose and honey tones.

sources.title: Illinois Extension: Snapdragon
sources.note: Very cold tolerant; good for early spring and fall planting and does well until a very hard frost. Full sun to light shade, well-drained soil; 6 in to 3 ft; blooms May to October. Remove spent spikes to promote rebloom; stake tall kinds.

sources.title: ASPCA: Common Snapdragon
sources.note: Non-toxic to dogs, cats and horses.

companions.why: Recommended companions: zinnia, Japanese anemones, coreopsis, black-eyed Susans and coneflowers.
